basic_details.job_title: ABV-IIITM Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Information Technology at ABV Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management (ABV-IIITM), Gwalior, has advertised a Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in the ANRF-sponsored project "ExAID" under Dr. Saswata Roy. The fellowship is Rs. 37,000 + HRA (18%), initially for one year. Candidates need a postgraduate degree in the listed disciplines, or a B.E./B.Tech. with a valid GATE score, or a postgraduate degree in Basic Sciences with valid NET/GATE. Fill in the Google form and email the CV and Annexure I to [email protected] by 25 November 2026.

rows.details: ABV Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management (ABV-IIITM), Gwalior
ExAID: An Explainable AI-Driven Multilingual Deepfake Detection tool with Browser Integration
Initially one year, may be extended up to two additional years; maximum three years
Google form, plus CV and application form by email

content_sections.heading: About ABV-IIITM
content_sections.text: ABV-IIITM, Gwalior is described in the notice as an autonomous institute under MHRD, Government of India. Its address is NH-10, Morena Link Road, Gwalior – 474015 (M.P.), India. The project is supervised by Dr. Saswata Roy, Assistant Professor, Department of Information Technology. The ExAID project aims to develop an Explainable Multimodal Deepfake Detection framework for identifying AI-generated and manipulated content. It combines deep learning models with Explainable AI techniques and an artificial thresholding mechanism. The project will also build a multilingual audio-visual deepfake dataset covering regional languages and different demographic groups, including children, men, women and elderly individuals. It will develop real-time detection through browser extensions and social media integration, and a web-based dashboard.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is any one of the following, as printed in the notice: Postgraduate Degree (M.E./M.Tech./M.S.) in Computer Science / Information Technology / Electronics and Communication Engineering / Electrical Engineering or related fields, OR Graduate Degree (B.E./B.Tech.) in the above disciplines with a valid GATE score, OR Postgraduate Degree in Basic Sciences (such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics) with a valid NET/GATE qualification. Desirable qualifications: Must have a mathematical background. Good knowledge of Machine Learning or Deep Neural Network. Proficiency in Python and Deep learning platforms such as Pytorch/Keras/Tensorflow. The notice does not mention an age limit or a required work experience. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is Rs. 37,000 + HRA (18%), as per ANRF and Institute norms and subject to availability of funds. The position is initially for one year. It may be extended for up to two additional years based on performance or till the completion of the project, whichever is earlier. The total duration extends for a maximum of three years. If performance is unsatisfactory, the position can be terminated with one month's notice. Selected candidates can be enrolled in the Ph.D. programme as per the institute's norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ABV-IIITM Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Detailed CV with academic details (percentage/CGPA), research work/projects and work experience (if any). Application form (Annexure I).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail about the interview. The interview will be conducted in person (offline mode) at ABV-IIITM Gwalior. The interview date is not specified in the notice. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Both steps are asked for: the Google form and the email with CV and Annexure I. The fellowship is subject to availability of funds. No TA/DA is provided for the interview. For queries, the notice gives the phone number +91-7761807224 and the email [email protected] .
